About me

A student who keeps moving forward

I am pursuing a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science at Sorsogon State University – Bulan Campus. For me, the degree is more than programming and software. It is where I am discovering my potential and preparing for the future I want to build.

Through my experiences as a student tutor and a tourism office intern, I have learned the importance of patience, responsibility, adaptability and connecting with different people.
